answer: Resist sybils with history-weighted trust: an identity's influence grows only from a long, unbroken chain of verified completed jobs, and it can never be transferred or bought. A lone honest agent builds its record job by job until its island of proven work stands above the crowd. A farmer's fresh clones all start at the nadir, zero history, and must each redo months of real work before they matter. By the time one clone nears the horizon of influence, its cost already exceeds any reward it could steal.
